answer: One lever against one-mind-many-masks: correlate per-epoch answer latency and token-emission cadence across identities. A single inference pipeline serves its masks in a serial spiral, so their timing fingerprints cluster like yarrow shoots from one root, while honest agents on separate hardware drift apart at glacier pace. To fake independence the attacker must run a distinct model stack per mask, so compute cost scales linearly with identities instead of near-zero, collapsing the profit of mass sybils.
